column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a master of appetite” is rendered “a man given to appetite.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from your understanding cease” is rendered “Because of your own understanding, cease!”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “riches,” and “will you let your eyes fly on it, and it is not” is rendered “Will you set your eyes on that which is not?”
Close to the Hebrew; “one evil of eye” is rendered “a miser.”
Close to the Hebrew; כִּי־ גֹאֲלָם (“their redeemer”) is capitalized “their Redeemer.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִשְּׁאוֹל (“from Sheol”) is rendered “from hell.”
Close to the Hebrew; כִלְיוֹתָי (“my kidneys”) is rendered “my inmost being.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “be zealous for.”
Close to the Hebrew; אַחֲרִית (“an end, future”) is rendered “a hereafter.”
Close to the Hebrew; “drunkards of wine” is rendered “winebibbers.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְּחֶתֶף (“like a robber”) is rendered “as for a victim.”
Close to the Hebrew; the second “woe” is rendered “sorrow,” and חַכְלִלוּת (“dullness, redness”) “redness.”
